contract.note: Independent learning after assistance ends is a fair measure. Reading negligible learning as negligible total acquisition is ordinary, though the unspecified population and usage pattern limit generalization.

evidence.note: The randomized mathematics study supports harm from ordinary GPT access in that setting. A 17% relative performance reduction does not establish negligible total learning.

The revised preprint reports substantial unaided pre/post gains with ChatGPT access, contradicting negligible total learning. Nonsignificant treatment differences establish neither equivalence nor chatbot-caused gains.

reviews.rationale: Randomized mathematics evidence supports harm in one setting. Substantial independent learning gains in the coding experiments contradict the negligible-learning component under the contract's fair reading. Neither study establishes general prevalence or durable retention.
